SCL-05.rule: explicit source/profile morale-check resolution plus visibility-safe tactical cohesion, leadership and discipline evidence; no random roll, universal morale pool, discipline scale or canonical consequence execution

SCL-06.rule: visibility-first deterministic owner-backed logistics/readiness evidence projection plus read-only support handoffs only; no resource consumption/transfer, Economy settlement, HP repair, reinforcement arrival commit, campaign-time advance, readiness auto-derivation, owner mutation or duplicate logistics ledger

governed_contract.rule: Visibility-first deterministic owner-backed terrain/zone/objective/siege-context/strategic-position projection plus read-only source/effect/handoff references only. Source effects/objectives are represented, never mechanically applied or completed by SCL-07.

boundaries: ordinary World/location, Combat/Action/Event, Asset, Organization and Permission/visibility owner truth remains authoritative
source terrain effects and scenario objectives are read-only references/handoffs, not SCL-07 canonical outcome application
absent siege, objective-lifecycle and strategic-position formulas remain explicit gaps and are never invented
SCL-08 retains vehicle/fleet operational integration; SCL-09 retains casualty/damage/recovery; SCL-10 retains strategic consequences
AI has no autonomous command/adjudication authority
